comment: The interoperability guidance should include a minimum profile for clinical research, laboratories and biobanks. This is relevant to institutions that link participant care, research, diagnostics and biospecimen repositories.

anchor.note: placed on the block, by a placement agent reading the comment against the text (medium): Asks for a minimum FHIR profile for research/labs; this §4.3.3 block defines minimum FHIR resources per component.

public.text: The interoperability guidance should include a minimum profile for clinical research, laboratories and biobanks. This is relevant to institutions that link participant care, research, diagnostics and biospecimen repositories.
public.suggestedRevision: Recommend exchange using Patient, ResearchSubject, ResearchStudy, Consent, ServiceRequest, Specimen, Observation, DiagnosticReport, DocumentReference and Provenance, with national implementation guides and terminology bindings.
